title: Parse: Extract requirements from Routing Dispatch
description:
Read spec section, extract MUST/SHALL/SHOULD statements, create checklist in task description

## Routing Dispatch Requirements (spec/05-routing.md §7.2-7.3)

### Address Classification (§7.2)
- [ ] Link-local (fe80::/10): Send directly to neighbor
- [ ] Primary 02xx (Yggdrasil-derived): Local mesh peer via gradient or LOADng
- [ ] Primary 02xx off-mesh: Yggdrasil-routable via RPL to border router
- [ ] Other/Unknown: Off-mesh via RPL to border router

### Routing Decision Order (§7.2)
- [ ] For 02xx addresses: local mesh first (gradient, LOADng, RPL) before Yggdrasil fallback
- [ ] Gradient table lookup (announce or passive) - first priority
- [ ] LOADng discovery (if no gradient) - second priority
- [ ] RPL via parent (if destination known in DODAG) - third priority
- [ ] Yggdrasil fallback via BR TUN (off-mesh or unreachable locally) - final fallback

### is_off_mesh() Logic (§7.2)
- [ ] Link-local: always returns False
- [ ] Non-02xx: always returns True
- [ ] 02xx: returns True only when gradient_table.lookup() is None AND has_rpl_route() is False

### Core Protocol - Constrained Devices (§7.3)
- [ ] MUST: RPL join (DIO/DIS/DAO)
- [ ] MUST: Announce send
- [ ] MUST: Announce receive + gradient install
- [ ] SHOULD: Announce relay
- [ ] MUST: LOADng originate (RREQ/RREP)
- [ ] SHOULD: LOADng relay
- [ ] MUST: Gradient table (§11)

### Core Protocol - Routers (§7.3)
- [ ] MUST: RPL join (DIO/DIS/DAO)
- [ ] MUST: Announce send
- [ ] MUST: Announce receive + gradient install
- [ ] MUST: Announce relay
- [ ] MUST: LOADng originate (RREQ/RREP)
- [ ] MUST: LOADng relay
- [ ] MUST: Gradient table (§11)

### Core Protocol - Border Routers (§7.3)
- [ ] MUST: RPL join (DIO/DIS/DAO)
- [ ] MUST: Announce send
- [ ] MUST: Announce receive + gradient install
- [ ] MUST: Announce relay
- [ ] MUST: LOADng originate (RREQ/RREP)
- [ ] MUST: LOADng relay
- [ ] MUST: Gradient table (§11)

### Extended Features (§7.3)
- [ ] MAY: Geographic coords in announce (all device classes)
- [ ] MAY: GPSR fallback (Router/BR only)
- [ ] MAY/SHOULD: Backpressure tracking (Router MAY, BR SHOULD)
- [ ] MAY/SHOULD: Store-and-forward/DTN (Router MAY, BR SHOULD)
- [ ] MAY: Opportunistic forwarding (Router/BR)

### L2 Dispatch Bytes
- [ ] 0x14: SCHC-compressed IPv6 packet
- [ ] 0x15: LICHEN routing/control messages (Announce, RPL, LOADng)
- [ ] Receivers MUST NOT treat unwrapped link payload beginning with 0x01 as announce (SCHC global CoAP also uses rule ID 0x01)
